notes.title: City Quest 1.1 releases
notes.content:
City Quest 1.1 has released with a number of bug fixes, including but not limited to:
-Blast from the Past achievement should now fire properly.
-Fixes to the plane minigame.
-Spelling and grammar corrections
-Fixes to cab intro scene

More updates coming soon!
